arxiv-2202-10073.title: Use of algebraic dual representations in domain decomposition methods for Darcy flow in 3D domains
arxiv-2202-10073.creator: V. Jain, A. Palha, M. Gerritsma
arxiv-2202-10073.description: Abstract In this work we use algebraic dual representations in conjunction with domain decomposition methods for Darcy equations. We define the broken Sobolev spaces and their finite dimensional counterparts. In addition, a global trace space is defined that connects the solution between the broken spaces.

arxiv-2203-04521.title: Character stacks are PORC count
arxiv-2203-04521.creator: Nick Bridger, Masoud Kamgarpour
arxiv-2203-04521.description: Abstract . We compute the number of points over finite fields of the character stack associated to a compact surface group and a reductive group with connected centre. We find that the answer is a Polynomial On Residue Classes (PORC).

arxiv-2205-12102.title: KQGC: Knowledge Graph Embedding with Smoothing Effects of Graph Convolutions for Recommendation DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: the 31st ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM ’22); October 17–22, 2022; Atlanta, Georgia Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2205-12102.creator: Daisuke Kikuta 1∗ , Toyotaro Suzumura 1,3 , Md Mostafizur Rahman 1 , Yu Hirate 1 , Satyen Abrol 2 , Manoj Kondapaka 2 , Takuma Ebisu 1 , Pablo Loyola 1
arxiv-2205-12102.description: Abstract . Leveraging graphs on recommender systems has gained popularity with the development of graph representation learning (GRL). In particular, knowledge graph embedding (KGE) and graph neural networks (GNNs) are representative GRL approaches, which have achieved the state-of-the-art performance on several recommendation tasks. Furthermore, combination of KGE and GNNs (KG-GNNs) has been explored and found effective in many academic literatures.

arxiv-2206-13281.title: Extracting Large Scale Spatio-Temporal Descriptions from Social Media
arxiv-2206-13281.creator: Carlo Bono, Barbara Pernici
arxiv-2206-13281.description: Abstract The ability to track large-scale events as they happen is essential for understanding them and coordinating reactions in an appropriate and timely manner. This is true, for example, in emergency management and decision-making support, where the constraints on both quality and latency of the extracted information can be stringent.

arxiv-2302-04161.title: Masking Kernel for Learning Energy-Efficient Representations for Speaker Recognition and Mobile Health
arxiv-2302-04161.creator: Apiwat Ditthapron, Emmanuel O. Agu, Adam C. Lammert
arxiv-2302-04161.description: Abstract Modern smartphones possess hardware for audio acquisition and to perform speech processing tasks such as speaker recognition and health assessment. However, energy consumption remains a concern, especially for resource-intensive DNNs. Prior work has improved the DNN energy efficiency by utilizing a compact model or reducing the dimensions of speech features.

arxiv-2310-00199.title: DeformUX-Net: Exploring a 3D Foundation Backbone for Medical Image Segmentation with Depthwise Deformable Convolution
arxiv-2310-00199.creator: Ho Hin Lee, Quan Liu, Qi Yang, Xin Yu, Shunxing Bao, Yuankai Huo, Bennett A. Landman
arxiv-2310-00199.description: Abstract The application of 3D ViTs to medical image segmentation has seen remarkable strides, somewhat overshadowing the budding advancements in Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based models. Large kernel depthwise convolution has emerged as a promising technique, showcasing capabilities akin to hierarchical transformers and facilitating an expansive effective receptive field (ERF) vital for dense predictions.

arxiv-2402-07682.title: Auxiliary Tasks to Boost Biaffine Semantic Dependency Parsing
arxiv-2402-07682.creator: Marie Candito
arxiv-2402-07682.description: Abstract The biaffine parser of Dozat and Manning 2017 was successfully extended to semantic dependency parsing (SDP) Dozat and Manning 2018 . Its performance on graphs is surprisingly high given that, without the constraint of producing a tree, all arcs for a given sentence are predicted independently from each other (modulo a shared representation of tokens).

arxiv-2404-16488.title: Two-Dimensional Eclipse Mapping of the Hot Jupiter WASP-43b with JWST MIRI/LRS
arxiv-2404-16488.creator: Mark Hammond, Taylor J. Bell, Ryan C. Challener, Neil T. Lewis, Megan Weiner Mansfield, Isaac Malsky, Emily Rauscher, Jacob L. Bean, Ludmila Carone, João M. Mendonça, Lucas Teinturier, Xianyu Tan, Nicolas Crouzet, Laura Kreidberg, Giuseppe Morello, Vivien Parmentier, Jasmina Blecic, Jean-Michel Dése
arxiv-2404-16488.description: Abstract We present eclipse maps of the two-dimensional thermal emission from the dayside of the hot Jupiter WASP-43b, derived from an observation of a phase curve with the JWST MIRI/LRS instrument. The observed eclipse shapes deviate significantly from those expected for a planet emitting uniformly over its surface.

arxiv-2406-01561.title: Guided Score identity Distillation for Data-Free One-Step Text-to-Image Generation
arxiv-2406-01561.creator: Mingyuan Zhou, Zhendong Wang, Huangjie Zheng, Hai Huang
arxiv-2406-01561.description: Abstract Diffusion-based text-to-image generation models trained on extensive text-image pairs have demonstrated the ability to produce photorealistic images aligned with textual descriptions. However, a significant limitation of these models is their slow sample generation process, which requires iterative refinement through the same network.

arxiv-2406-09675.title: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Spectral GNNs: The Impact on Efficiency, Memory, and Effectiveness
arxiv-2406-09675.creator: Ningyi Liao, Haoyu Liu, Zulun Zhu, Siqiang Luo, Laks V.S. Lakshmanan
arxiv-2406-09675.description: Abstract . With recent advancements in graph neural networks (GNNs), spectral GNNs have received increasing popularity by virtue of their ability to retrieve graph signals in the spectral domain. These models feature uniqueness in efficient computation as well as rich expressiveness, which stems from advanced management and profound understanding of graph data.

arxiv-2410-15011.title: Giant Topological Hall Effect in Magnetic Weyl Metal Mn 2 Pd 0.5 Ir 0.5 Sn
arxiv-2410-15011.creator: Arnab Bhattacharya ‡, Sreeparvathy PC ‡, Afsar Ahmed, Daichi Kurebayashi, Oleg A. Tretiakov, Biswarup Satpati, Samik DuttaGupta, Aftab Alam, I. Das
arxiv-2410-15011.description: Abstract The synergy between real and reciprocal space topology is anticipated to yield a diverse array of topological properties in quantum materials. We address this pursuit by achieving topologically safeguarded magnetic order in novel Weyl metallic Heusler alloy, Mn 2 Pd 0.5 Ir 0.5 Sn. The system possesses non-centrosymmetric D 2d crystal symmetry with notable spin-orbit coupling effects.

arxiv-2507-02649.title: Restricted Quasiconvexity Isometry Property for Symmetric α \alpha -Stable Random Matrices
arxiv-2507-02649.creator: Sunder Ram Krishnan
arxiv-2507-02649.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sunder Ram Krishnan. We formulate a generalization of the Restricted Isometry Property (RIP) referred to as the Restricted Quasiconvexity Isometry Property (RQIP) for alpha stable random projections with 0 < α < 1 0<\alpha<1 . A lower bound on the number of rows for RQIP to hold for random matrices whose entries are drawn from a symmetric α \alpha -stable ( S ​ α ​ S S\alpha S ) distribution is derived.

arxiv-2510-02708.title: Ultra-strong Mg ii absorbers trace both inflowing and outflowing gas: insights from dual down-the-barrel and quasar sightlines 2025 Ultra-strong Mg ii absorbers trace both inflowing and outflowing gas: insights from dual down-the-barrel and quasar sightlines – References
arxiv-2510-02708.creator: Antonia Fernández-Figueroa, Glenn G. Kacprzak, Tania M. Barone, Nikole M. Nielsen, Kate H. R. Rubin, Andrew J. Pitts, Barbara Mazzilli Ciraulo
arxiv-2510-02708.description: Abstract We present Keck/LRIS spectroscopy of seven isolated galaxy–quasar pairs at 0.4 ≤ z ≤ 0.6 0.4\leq z\leq 0.6 , each exhibiting ultra-strong Mg ii absorption ( W r , 2796 ≥ 3 W_{r,2796}\geq 3 Å), probing both down-the-barrel and transverse gas flows.

AS was supported by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation and also by the Swedish Research Council Grant 2023-03411. SY was supported by the Nationa
arxiv-2510-11371.creator: Jens Marklof, Andreas Strömbergsson, Shucheng Yu
arxiv-2510-11371.description: Abstract . This paper extends a recent extreme value law for horocycle flows on the space of two-dimensional lattices, due to Kirsebom and Mallahi-Karai, to the simplest examples of rank- k k unipotent actions on the space of n n -dimensional lattices.

arxiv-2510-14017.title: Quantized Skeletal Learning (QSL): A Differentiable Programming Approach for Skeletal Reduction of Chemical Mechanisms
arxiv-2510-14017.creator: Opeoluwa Owoyele
arxiv-2510-14017.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Opeoluwa Owoyele. This paper presents a data-driven approach, referred to as Quantized Skeletal Learning (QSL), for generating skeletal mechanisms. The approach has two key components: (1) a weight vector that can be used to eliminate relatively unimportant species and reactions, and (2) an end-to-end differentiable program whose loss-function gradients, with respect to the weight vector, can be used to adjust those weights.

plos-pone-0002760.creator: David González, María-Jesús Grilló, María-Jesús De Miguel et al.
plos-pone-0002760.description: PLOS ONE research article. The brucellae are facultative intracellular bacteria that cause brucellosis, one of the major neglected zoonoses. In endemic areas, vaccination is the only effective way to control this disease. Brucella melitensis Rev 1 is a vaccine effective against the brucellosis of sheep and

pmc-10553585.title: SAT160 Alcoholic Ketoacidosis : An Endocrine Emergency
pmc-10553585.creator: Leo Jr Estabillo Tiu, Thelma D Crisostomo
pmc-10553585.description: Disclosure: L.E. Tiu: None. T.D. Crisostomo: None. Background: Alcoholic Ketoacidosis is a complex metabolic condition frequently confused with Diabetic Ketoacidosis. Currently, there remains an undefined consensus guideline in the diagnosis and management of this disorder that leads to unreported cases.

pmc-11662329.title: Measurement of ground reaction forces in cats after total hip replacement
pmc-11662329.creator: Gregor Schweng, Barbara Bockstahler, Alexander Tichy, Klaus Zahn, Georg Haimel, Günter Schwarz, Eva Schnabl-Feichter
pmc-11662329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to evaluate ground reaction forces (GRFs) in cats after unilateral total hip replacement (THR) and compare them with cats after femoral head and neck ostectomy (FHO).MethodsThe databases of the Small Animal Clinic of the Veterinary University in Vienna and three referral clinics were searched for cats that had undergone unilateral THR with the BioMedtrix Micro total hip system or FHO more than 6 months previously.

pmc-11713519.title: Novel MRI method enables in vivo quantification of pre‐atrophic neurodegeneration in a mouse model of Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-11713519.creator: Michal R Tomaszewski, Alexander L Sukstansky, Hyking D Haley, Xiangjun Meng, Corin O Miller, Dmitriy A Yablonskiy
pmc-11713519.description: BackgroundRobust methods are needed for preclinical evaluation of novel Alzheimer Disease (AD) therapies to accelerate drug discovery. Quantitative Gradient Recalled Echo (qGRE) MRI shows significant promise to provide insight into neurodegeneration in AD prior to atrophy development in humans, with qGRE R2t* metric (tissue‐specific subcomponent of R2*) highlighting areas of low neuronal density (doi:10.3233/JAD‐210503).

pmc-11771973.title: Changes in CD4+CD25HIGH T cells and TGFβ1 levels in different stages of adult-onset type 1 diabetes
pmc-11771973.creator: Tanja Miličić, Aleksandra Jotić, Ivanka Marković, Dušan Popadić, Katarina Lalić, Veljko Uskoković, Ljiljana Lukić, Marija Maćešić, Jelena Stanarčić, Milica Stoiljković, Mina Milovančević, Đurđa Rafailović, Aleksandra Božović, Nina Radisavljević, Nebojša M. Lalić
pmc-11771973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPrevious studies suggested an important role of impairments in T cell subsets in different stages during type 1 diabetes (T1D) development, while data regarding CD25high T cells and transforming growth factor b1 (TGFβ1), both T regulatory associated, remains controversial.

pmc-12403879.title: Comorbidities in spinal muscular atrophy and their impact on the course of the underlying disease: a real-life observational study
pmc-12403879.creator: Małgorzata Błauciak, Jakub Ubysz, Małgorzata Wieczorek, Magdalena Koszewicz
pmc-12403879.description: BackgroundThe lack of the SMN protein in SMA affects different tissues and organs, not only alpha motoneurons; this creates a broad spectrum of potential concomitant diseases, making SMA a multidisciplinary problem. This study focuses on an analysis of comorbidities, and their frequence and severity in SMA.

pmc-12428421.title: Morpho-Functional and Biochemical Characterization of Adrenal Masses in a Heterogeneous Cancer Population
pmc-12428421.creator: Rosaria Meucci, Antonio Stigliano, Giuseppe Campagna, Francesco Garaci, Tommaso Pintus, Guido Roberto, Alberto Signore
pmc-12428421.description: Simple SummaryThe aim of this retrospective study is to analyze the prevalence of adrenal masses in paients with different types of tumors who performed [18F]FDG PET/CT. We analyze 88 patients who performed [18F]FDG PET/CT from 2019 to 2024 for oncologic purposes, with evidence of adrenal mass and different types of cancer, which were retrospectively retrieved from our database.

pmc-12617902.title: Enhanced multi-horizon photovoltaic power forecasting: A novel approach integrating ICEEMDAN decomposition with hierarchical frequency neural networks
pmc-12617902.creator: Yaopeng Han, Chenxi Li, Siqi Chen, Jinghao Zhao, Yajun Tian, Jun Wang, Sibarama Panigrahi, Sibarama Panigrahi, Sibarama Panigrahi
pmc-12617902.description: As a crucial renewable energy source, solar PV power generation drives environmental protection and energy transformation. However, existing forecasting models struggle to accurately capture the complex dynamics of photovoltaic (PV) power, primarily due to monolithic modeling paradigms and inadequate representation of temporal information.

pmc-12652039.title: Mechanistic Insights into the Anti-Inflammatory and Anti-Proliferative Effects of Selected Medicinal Plants in Endometriosis
pmc-12652039.creator: Oliwia Burdan, Natalia Picheta, Julia Piekarz, Karolina Daniłowska, Filip Gajewski, Krzysztof Kułak, Rafał Tarkowski, Alfonso Baldi
pmc-12652039.description: Endometriosis involves oestrogen-dependent chronic inflammation and the abnormal proliferation of ectopic endometrial tissue. Conventional hormonal therapies suppress systemic oestrogen, but do not fully address local oxidative and inflammatory signalling. This review provides a mechanistic synthesis of recent molecular evidence. This evidence is on four FDA-recognized (Food and Drug Administration) medicinal plants.

pmc-12690851.title: Associations between mediterranean diet adherence, binge eating behavior, and oral health-related quality of life in adults
pmc-12690851.creator: Emine Merve Ekici, Sena Yücel, Ümmügülsüm Güler, Emine Tuğçe Ersoy, Özge Mengi Çelik
pmc-12690851.description: BackgroundDespite growing recognition of the complex interplay between eating patterns and health outcomes, few studies have simultaneously examined the associations between Mediterranean diet adherence, binge eating behavior, and oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL). This study aimed to address this gap by exploring these variables in a large adult population.

pmc-13198257.title: An aerosolized dual-action autotaxin inhibitor-PPARγ agonist for the treatment of pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-13198257.creator: Alexios N. Matralis, Elli-Anna Stylianaki, Eleni M. Ladopoulou, Paraskevi Kanellopoulou, Stefanos Smyrniotis, Christiana Magkrioti, Konstantinos D. Papavasileiou, Sabine Willems, Juan Pablo Rincon Pabon, Dimitris Nastos, Alexandros Galaras, Céline Moro, Skarlatos G. Dedos, Eleanna Kaffe, Pantelis Ha
pmc-13198257.description: SummaryIdiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a fatal fibrotic interstitial lung disease (ILD) with limited therapeutic options. Autotaxin (ATX), an established drug target in IPF, is a secreted lysophospholipase D that catalyzes the extracellular production of lysophosphatidic acid (LPA), a growth-factor-like signaling phospholipid.

pmc-13417149.title: Contamination, Source Apportionment and Probabilistic Health Risk of Potentially Toxic Elements in Surface Sediments of the Anning River Basin
pmc-13417149.creator: Wenkai Wang, Pengfei Che, Jinjin Wang, Yue Rao, Jian Luo, Jianbin Chen, Junxi Wang, Yanchang Kun
pmc-13417149.description: The Anning River, traversing the mineral-rich Panxi region, is highly susceptible to contamination by potentially toxic elements (PTEs). This study systematically investigated the contamination profiles, source apportionment, and probabilistic human health risks of eight PTEs in the surface sediments of the basin.

pmc-13468763.title: Advances in Computer Vision and Sensor-Based Methods for Intelligent Power Transmission Line Inspection
pmc-13468763.creator: Vasileios N. Kouris, Eleni Vrochidou, George A. Papakostas

pmc-13487157.title: ProLM: a plasma proteomics pretrained model for the general population
pmc-13487157.creator: Shizheng Qiu, Ming Zhao, Xin Chen, Zhishuai Zhang, Huanyu You, Xu Sun, Jirui Guo, Haozheng Liang, Yu Guo, Lu Chen, Jun Lv, Dianjianyi Sun, Ling Yang, Yiping Chen, Huaidong Du, Zhengming Chen, Liming Li, Yang Hu, Guiyou Liu, Canqing Yu, Yadong Wang
pmc-13487157.description: Plasma proteomics can provide a dynamic molecular readout of human health, but models that learn generalizable protein-expression patterns in population cohorts remain limited. Here we show that ProLM, a BERT-based plasma proteomics model pretrained on 15,499 relatively healthy UK Biobank participants, captures baseline protein-expression relationships and supports prediction of 16 common chronic diseases.

uslaw-usc-t49-s5309.title: 49 U.S.C. § 5309 — Fixed guideway capital investment grants
uslaw-usc-t49-s5309.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s5309.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Chapter 53 (Public Transportation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions.— In this section, the following definitions shall apply: (1) Applicant.— The term “applicant” means a State or local governmental authority that applies for a grant under this section. (2) Core capacity improvement project.— The term “core capacity improvement project” means a substantial corridor-based capital investment.
